Title: Windows 11 public preview is now available on Azure Virtual Desktop

Body.Content:
Azure Virtual Desktop is a great place for you to set up your validation environment to try out the new Windows 11 operating system. Visit the Azure Marketplace to choose from three Windows 11 images: 

  • Windows 11 Enterprise (Preview) 
  • Windows 11 Enterprise multi-session (Preview) 
  • Windows 11 Enterprise multi-session + Microsoft 365 Apps (Preview) 

Learn more.
